steps.label: before-tap
steps.js: () => ({ htmlHasMap: document.body.innerHTML.includes('Kartan är inte tillgänglig'), tabs: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]')).map(t => ({ label: t.getAttribute('aria-label'), selected: t.getAttribute('aria-selected'), rect: t.getBoundingClientRect().top })) })

steps.label: after-tap
steps.js: () => ({ htmlHasMap: document.body.innerHTML.includes('Kartan är inte tillgänglig'), htmlHasKartan: document.body.innerHTML.includes('Kartan'), tabs: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]')).map(t => ({ label: t.getAttribute('aria-label'), selected: t.getAttribute('aria-selected') })), panels: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('body *')).filter(e => e.textContent && e.textContent.trim().startsWith('Kartan är inte')).slice(0,2).map(e => ({ tag: e.tagName, display: getComputedStyle(e.parentElement).display, parentDisplay: getComputedStyle(e.parentElement.parentElement).display })) })
